name: Things Native
designIntent: Native productivity notes with crisp controls and compact navigation.
visualIdentity: Mac-like control density, rounded selection rails, compact file navigation.

tokenStrategy.headingFont: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

acceptanceCriteria: Light and dark modes are both present and independently tokenized.
Document width is not overridden by theme CSS.
File tree row height is controlled only through --reader-file-tree-row-height.
At least three non-color differentiators are visible in preview fixtures.
